base.description: Same 64x64 pixel-art human fighter, same side pose facing right, same face, navy T-shirt, beige trousers, purple shoes, bare fists, palette and proportions. Remove all hair: completely shaved bald head with a smooth skin-coloured scalp and a clean dark outline around the round skull, ear visible. Nothing else changes. Transparent background.

animations.name: jab
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. From this compact fighting stance with bare fists, extend only the lead fist straight to the RIGHT in one quick punch, then retract it to the exact initial stance. Rear fist stays near the cheek, elbows tucked. Never face camera, never spread arms sideways. Feet planted, fixed camera, same bald character and palette.

animations.name: hook
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. From this tight stance, rotate the torso slightly and swing the rear fist in a short hook to the RIGHT, then retract to the exact initial stance. Lead fist protects the chin throughout. No frontal pose or arms spread left and right. Fixed camera, planted feet, same bald character and colors.

animations.name: power
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. From the stance, bend knees slightly, pull the lead fist beside the chin, then drive a powerful straight two-handed push toward the RIGHT and return to the exact initial stance. Elbows stay close to ribs. Never face camera or spread arms sideways. Same bald character, colors, fixed camera, no projectiles.

animations.name: hurt
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. Take one hit from the RIGHT, recoil shoulders and head slightly to the LEFT while keeping both fists close together in front of the chin. Recover into the exact initial stance. Elbows tucked, no arms spread sideways. Same bald character, colors and fixed camera.

animations.name: defeat
animations.action: Strict side view facing RIGHT. Take a final hit from the right, knees buckle, stagger backward to the left and fall onto the floor, ending lying down motionless. Keep the same bald human fighter, clothing and colors, full body visible, transparent background and fixed camera. Do not stand back up.

headItems.description: Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add short messy medium-brown hair with a few spiky tufts, covering the top and back of the skull, sideburn above the ear on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add a medium-brown mohawk: a tall strip of spiky hair along the middle of the skull, sides shaved on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add medium-brown hair pulled back into a short high ponytail sticking out behind the head on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add a bright red knitted winter beanie hat covering the top of the skull down to the ear, with a folded brim on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add a bright blue baseball cap with the visor pointing forward to the right on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

processing: Frames packed into a 576x384 atlas (rows idle, jab, hook, power, hurt, defeat; column 0 repeats idle) on the y=54 ground line. Head items are the difference between each edit and the bald idle frame, limited to the head and non-skin pixels. anchors.json stores, per atlas cell, the translation and rotation that best fit the idle head skin mask, searched within plus or minus 20 degrees except in the defeat row. The groove rows (cells 55 to 71) had transparent eye pixels refilled from the idle head, and the last defeat cell (53) is the final frame of a PixelLab animation that starts from cell 52, in which the head sinks onto the floor with the face still in profile; the idle head is restamped at its fitted angle so head items fit, and the floor value stops them at the y=54 ground line.

Change only the pose to running: mid-stride side view facing right, front knee lifted, rear leg pushing back, elbows bent about 90 degrees, arms swinging, relaxed open fists. Feet on the same ground line, full body visible.

animation.action: Seamless looping running cycle in place. Strict SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT every frame, never turn toward the camera. Alpha is cut at 128, colours snap to the outfit palette, the exact front head is pasted at the tracked head position so the front hair and hat overlays fit in every frame, and frames keep the front view placement so overlays have room above the head. Colours are then remapped so every material keeps the same shade step it has in the front view, so the recoloured dance matches the front sprite, including the zip and folds.

the hand at the end of the straight arm is turned sideways and seen edge-on: a flat open hand pointing straight at the viewer, fingertips toward the camera, palm facing sideways, so it looks like a thin vertical blade with the thumb on top, not a palm facing the viewer, same skin colour and dark outline

bluza.transplant: the generated outfit frames drew the forward hand differently in every frame, so the upper body above the waist is rebuilt from the matching baza frame: the head down to the chin and the waving hand (the largest piece of the pixels the hand wave moved in that frame) keep their skin, every other skin pixel of the arms is repainted with the light or shadow sleeve colour, and the tank top takes the outfit pixels at the same spot; the legs come from the outfit animation

dres.mask: clothes and arms, the head and both hands kept
dres.description: the same bald man wearing an orange tracksuit jacket with long orange sleeves down to the wrists with white stripes, black track pants with white side stripes and grey sneakers, one orange sleeve bent up to the hand covering his mouth, the other orange sleeve straight forward toward the viewer ending in the flat hand in front of the belly, no bare forearms, same dark outline
dres.transplant: the generated outfit frames drew the forward hand differently in every frame, so the upper body above the waist is rebuilt from the matching baza frame: the head down to the chin and the waving hand (the largest piece of the pixels the hand wave moved in that frame) keep their skin, every other skin pixel of the arms is repainted with the light or shadow sleeve colour, and the tank top takes the outfit pixels at the same spot; the legs come from the outfit animation
dres.rebuild: the generated tracksuit drifted between frames and hid the outfit, so every frame is redrawn on the base outfit frame of the same index: outlines, legs and shoes take the base shape, the T-shirt becomes the orange jacket body with a two-pixel grey zip down the middle that keeps its colour whatever jacket colour is chosen, a light zip pull at its top, a dark collar with white tips and a dark hem, bare arms become lighter orange sleeves with a white stripe along their top edge, the hands and the head keep the generated tracksuit pixels apart from stray shoe or trouser colours above the waist, which become sleeve, the trousers become black with a white stripe down the outer side of each leg, and the shoes turn grey

animation.action: scuba dance: relaxed natural sway of the hips and shoulders from side to side shifting weight between the feet, one hand covers the mouth, the other straight arm points forward with the hand edge-on waving left and right, feet stay planted
animation.keypoints: procedural, one sway per loop: hips 0.8 px, upper body 2.5 px, a 1.5 px knee bob on every weight shift, flat shoulder rolls 1.8 px forward and back with 40% vertical lift, 0.4 px shoulder tilt, the wrist waving 3 px four times per loop
animation.hand: the flat hand pixels are cut out with their outline, the uncovered clothing is filled from the same row, and the hand is shifted up to 3 px left and right four times per loop

scuba.processing: Alpha cut at 128, colours snapped to the outfit palette and small holes filled. No material or region fixes, so the track stripes and the hands stay as generated. The front head anchor is found from the top of the head only.

clean.steady: below the chin, a pixel that changes colour for exactly one frame and returns to the colour it had in the frames before and after is put back, so the dance keeps its sway and hand wave without flicker; the track suit jacket body is one colour with a darker line where it meets the sleeves, instead of copying the changing shading of the base tank top
clean.zip: the track suit zip is one pixel of b33d21, the darker jacket shade used in the front view
clean.hand: the waving hand is cut out and drawn again at the centre of the old hand in every frame, 30% further from the middle of its path: a 3 pixel wide hand hanging down with a cuff (white on the track suit, green on the hoodie, the wrist skin on the base outfit), light skin, a shaded edge and a dark outline, tilted toward the way it moves; on the base outfit the hand hangs two pixels lower and the bare forearm is drawn again as a slanted two pixel skin line with an outline from the elbow down to the wrist, so the arm stays whole; the arm at the nose is found by following its skin from the nose and the elbow and is never cut, shirt pixels enclosed by arm skin become skin, and dark shirt pixels the recolouring read as trousers take the shirt colour

danceTurn.shrink: the front dance rows 8, 9, 13 and 14 are scaled to 0.8 around the feet so the front body matches the side stance size and the feet stand on row 54 like every side frame; each new pixel takes the outline colour when at least 30% of its area is outline, stays transparent when at least half of it is empty and otherwise takes the colour covering most of it, and a light one-pixel detail between dark pixels such as the white of an eye is the eyes are placed back after scaling as the white of the eye with its pupil beside it, so the palette does not change and the eyes stay open; the front hair and hats are scaled the same way into dance/; the head is scaled once in the same pixel grid for every frame: each frame is moved back by its whole-pixel head offset, the head above the eyes comes from the first frame of the dance (cell 73 for Six-seven, 118 for Scuba), the head is scaled with outlines kept only where they cover more than half of a pixel, and it is put back moved by the scaled offset rounded to whole pixels, so the face, eyes, hair and hats stay the same in every frame
danceTurn.legs: in the hoodie Scuba rows 13, 14 and 16 the inner jeans pixels used the dark colour 242937 that the recolouring treats as outline, so the trousers kept their dark blue instead of the chosen colour; those pixels take the middle trouser shade 223856 and the outer outline stays
danceTurn.lying: the last defeat frame (cell 53) of baza and the hoodie raised the head with the chin on the floor, so the hair stood up; both now take the track suit frame, where the head rests lower at 20 degrees, with every pixel recoloured to the same material and shade of their own outfit (trousers one shade lighter, the white stripes take the colour around them) and the same head anchor
danceTurn.holes: the original background removal cut the white out of the track suit: the trouser stripes, the white parts of the shoes and the white of the eye were see-through in most frames; every enclosed see-through gap next to the trousers or shoes, and every one or two pixel gap inside the head, is filled with white (the lightest shoe colour next to the shoes), while the gaps between arms, hands and the body stay open
danceTurn.tee: the base outfit wore a T-shirt in the side frames but a tank top in the front view, the front dances and the turns; short sleeves are painted onto those frames before scaling: the arm skin within a few pixels of each shoulder and outside the torso outline takes the shirt colour of the same shade, the edge next to the bare arm takes the darkest shirt shade, and the old armhole outline between shirt pixels becomes that dark shade too; in Scuba the crossed arms make this unstable, so the sleeves there come from fixed shoulder boxes of cell 118 moved by each frame head offset
danceTurn.frontView: front/baza.png raises both fists in front of the chest, so painted sleeves landed on the fists; its torso rows 18 to 36 come from edit-image-pixen (seed 93003, second image, description: same bald fighter and pose, only the tank top becomes a short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt with the forearms and fists bare), snapped to the outfit palette without the shoe colours, with the head, legs and grey wrist wraps kept from the original
danceTurn.rows: row 15 turns into Six-seven and row 16 into Scuba: column 0 is the side stance, columns 1 to 4 are generated frames 2 to 5 snapped to the outfit palette and moved onto the stance ground line; clusters of up to 3 skin, trouser or shoe pixels lying mostly inside another material (trouser colour on a wrist, a skin speck on the trousers) take the colour around them
danceTurn.firstFrame: side stance, cell 0 of each outfit atlas

action.sixseven: The fighter drops the boxing guard and turns in place from a side view facing right to face the camera, ending standing upright facing the camera with both arms relaxed at the sides. Smooth natural body rotation through a three-quarter view, feet stay planted on the same ground line, the character keeps the same size. Same bald character, clothes and colours, full body visible, fixed camera, no ground, no effects.
action.scuba: The fighter drops the boxing guard and turns in place from a side view facing right to face the camera, ending facing the camera with one hand pinching the nose and the other arm raised across the chest, exactly like the last frame. Smooth natural body rotation through a three-quarter view, feet stay planted on the same ground line, the character keeps the same size. Same bald character, clothes and colours, full body visible, fixed camera, no ground, no effects.

shoeLeaks.rule: in every frame of every outfit, a group of pixels with a shoe colour that runs along the trousers (at least 1.5 trouser neighbours per pixel and starting more than 6 rows above the lowest pixel) or a group of up to 5 pixels above the hips is not a shoe; the recolouring painted them in the chosen shoe colour, so stripes and light pixels take the nearest kept white and darker pixels take the closest neighbouring colour of another material; a lone one or two pixel speck with a shoe colour anywhere above the shoes is treated the same way

dragged.processing: Alpha cut at 128 and every pixel snapped to the nearest colour of its outfit palette (OUTFIT_SPECS), then placed in the empty cell 140 of each atlas. The generated hoodie and tracksuit heads came out blurred, so their head and hands are the base pose pixels. Each anchors.json gets a cell 140 head anchor at angle 0, offset from that outfit's idle head by the shift of the head skin centroid, so hair and hats sit on the head.

front.then: edit-image-pixen to a relaxed stance with arms down; the hoodie is the base front re-dressed in a slim hoodie (seed 97701); the hoodie and tracksuit fronts carry the base front head

frontRedo.idle: front/<outfit>.png is a 16-frame breathing strip made from the front: the knees bend by a pixel, the chest lifts by a pixel on the inhale and the arms follow two frames later; the one-row gaps at the waist and shoulders are bridged by repeating the edge row, so no outline is left behind; front anchors list a head anchor per frame

dances.sixseven: animate-with-skeleton-v3 on the new front with the joint motion read (estimate-skeleton) from the previous Six-seven frames, the fixed front head stamped on every frame
dances.scuba: the previous Scuba frames of each outfit with the new head moved by the previous head offsets and the new legs; the hoodie greens are matched to the new hoodie; the knees dip by a pixel at both ends of the sway and the hips follow the sway by up to a pixel, fading to nothing at the knees

frontRedo.turn: animate-with-text-v3 from the side stance to the new front (seed 96503), four of its frames in columns 1 to 4 of rows 15 and 16
frontRedo.overlays: front/ and dance/ hair and hats are the difference between hair edits of the base front and the bald base front; light scalp-edge pixels left over from cutting the head out are removed from the hair overlays, so they do not turn into pale streaks after the hair recolour
frontRedo.processing: every new frame is moved so the feet stand on row 54 and snapped to the outfit palette by material: outline only on the silhouette edge or between face skin, skin only for clearly skin tones, shoes below the ankles, trousers only on the lower body, the rest to the nearest clothing material; each pixel then takes the nearest colour of its own material, the hoodie green is first tone-mapped to the previous hoodie; enclosed see-through gaps are filled
frontRedo.groove: animate-with-skeleton-v3 from the side stance of each outfit (seed 98203) with the joint motion read from the previous Luz frames, so the dancer turns from the side to the front and back to the beat; each frame gets a side or a front head anchor depending on which head template fits

crab.rows: rows 17 and 18, columns 1 to 8, each of the 8 poses held for two cells; the turn reuses the Six-seven turn in row 15

animation.from: the first frame of front/<outfit>.png and its estimate-skeleton keypoints
animation.keypoints: eight hand-placed poses: a deep wide squat with knees out, both arms raised beside the head like crab claws, the wrists closing in on every other pose, the body sliding sideways 3 pixels right and back with the leading foot sliding along the floor
animation.action: crab dance facing the viewer: deep wide squat with knees bent outward, both arms raised beside the head with bent elbows like crab claws, the hands snap open and shut like pincers, the body shuffles sideways sliding the feet along the floor, both feet always on the ground and fully visible with shoes, the head stays still facing the viewer

crab.processing: the front head of each outfit is located in every frame and replaced by the unchanged front head at that spot, so the face never changes; on the base T-shirt the white sleeve trims left behind by the raised arms are painted in the shirt colour; frames are lifted one pixel so the feet stand on row 54 like the other dances; every pixel already matched a colour of the outfit atlas; head anchors are the Six-seven reference anchor moved by the head offset

side.from: stance cell 0 of the base atlas

look.description: wearing a long dark charcoal grey hooded trench coat that reaches the knees, the hood lies down flat on the shoulders and back, thin glowing cyan trim lines along the coat edges and cuffs, coat open at the front over a black shirt, dark trousers and black boots; head stays bald

animations.method: for every animation the skeleton of each base atlas cell is estimated and moved onto the coat stance (side or front) by the difference to the base stance skeleton, then the coat is animated with those keypoints

runs.name: row1

coat.crab: the Crab dance with the coat front as the first frame, same keypoints and seed as the other outfits
coat.processing: the base head is located in every cell (with rotation for falls and lying cells) and replaced by the unchanged base head, which gives the head anchors; in the upper body pixels further than 3 pixels from the base silhouette are removed (glow streaks and beams the generator added), as are loose specks under 12 pixels; every pixel is snapped to the palette of the coat stance, coat front and base stances; held cells reuse the same frame; the front strip is the coat front with the same breathing as the other outfits; the profile is edit-image-pixen seed 87002 like the other outfits with the base head restamped

danceCleanup.specks: in every dance row (6 to 9 and 13 to 18) of baza, the hoodie and the track suit, and in every cell of the coat, small groups of up to six pixels whose colour the recolouring reads as another material than the pixels around them (skin specks on trousers, trouser and shirt specks on fists, shoe specks on legs) take the most common colour of the surrounding material at the same shade, and lone groups of fewer than twelve pixels away from the body are removed
danceCleanup.armOutlines: in the same dance rows, every clothing pixel that touches an arm or hand below the chin becomes the outline colour, so forearms crossing the chest stay visible with a light shirt and light skin
danceCleanup.turnSkin: the baza turn frames (cells 136 to 139 and 145 to 148) used darker skin colours than the rest of the dance, so their two darker skin shades move up by one

coatDances.from: the matching baza cell of every Groove, Six-seven, Scuba and turn frame (cells 55 to 62, 64 to 71, 73 to 80, 82 to 89, 118 to 125, 127 to 134, 136 to 139)
coatDances.description: Same bald fighter, same pose, head, hands and feet. Only the clothes change: a long bright red trench coat to the knees, open over a black shirt, thin glowing cyan trim on the front edges and hem. Sleeves cover the arms to the wrists with cyan cuffs, bare hands stay in place. Sleeves have a dark outline so the arms stand out. Light grey trousers, dark purple shoes.
coatDances.processing: of the two images the one closer to the previous frame is kept; every pixel gets a material from its colour and the baza pixel under it (red is the coat, dark pixels on the torso are the black shirt drawn in the outline colour, grey is trousers, purple at the feet or where baza has shoes is shoes, skin only next to baza skin) and takes the coat atlas colour of that material and shade, the head above the chin is copied from baza so the hair and hats keep the baza head anchors, cells 145 to 148 copy the turn, then the speck cleanup and arm outlines run on these cells

danceCleanup.handHoles: below the chin, grey pixels the recolouring keeps unchanged (mostly in the track suit fists) and clothing pixels that sit inside a hand take the skin colour of the same shade, so dark skin no longer shows grey holes in the fists
